title: Document requirements for advertiser verification - Brunei - Advertising Policies Help

facts.fact: Google may require advertisers to submit documents for advertiser verification, and the required documents depend on whether the account type is Organization or Individual.
facts.quote: The documents required are based on your account type “Organization” or “Individual”.

facts.fact: Organizations may be required to provide organization registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorized representative for advertiser verification.
facts.quote: **Organizations** may be required to provide 2 different types of documentation for advertiser verification: organization registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorized representative.

facts.fact: Individuals must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification program for advertiser verification.
facts.quote: **Individuals** must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification program.

facts.fact: For individual advertiser verification, the second proof-of-address document may be required in certain cases, and the address will not show in ad disclosure.
facts.quote: In certain cases, individuals may also be required to submit a second proof-of-address document matching the full name and address already submitted. The address won’t show in ad disclosure.

facts.fact: Government-issued photo IDs submitted for verification must be valid and not expired.
Photocopies, screenshots, or photos taken through third-party apps may not be accepted for government-issued photo ID submission during advertiser verification.
facts.quote: Photocopies, screenshots, or photos taken through third-party apps may not be accepted; we recommend using your device’s native camera app.

facts.fact: For advertiser verification, the front and back of the ID should be submitted separately when requested to prevent failing verification.
facts.quote: Submit the front and back of the ID separately when requested to prevent failing the verification.

facts.fact: Advertiser verification documents must be submitted only through the Ads UI and not by email.
facts.quote: Only submit the requested documents through the Ads UI, don't send them over email.

facts.fact: Common reasons for failed advertiser verification include the document being unverifiable, a name mismatch, or using an unsupported document type.
facts.quote: common reasons include the document being unverifiable, a name mismatch, or using an unsupported document type.

facts.fact: Personal data and documents submitted for advertiser verification are not shared with any third party, per Google's stated policy.
facts.quote: Personal data and documents won't be shared with any third party, as per the Google data protection policy.

facts.fact: An authorized representative for advertiser verification is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads, and the government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.
facts.quote: An authorized representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads. The government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.

facts.fact: Only government departments and agencies may use an official letter including full name, address and date as a registration document for advertiser verification.
facts.quote: Only for government departments and agencies: an official letter including full name, address and date

facts.fact: For Brunei advertiser verification, a utility (electricity, gas, or water bill) or phone or internet bill is an accepted address document only if it is dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A utility (for example, electricity, gas, water bill) or phone or internet bill (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: For Brunei advertiser verification, a bank statement is an accepted address document only if it is dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A bank statement (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: For Brunei advertiser verification, a second government-issued photo ID must be uploaded showing the side that displays the address.
facts.quote: A second government issued document of photo ID (make sure to upload the side showing the address)

facts.fact: For Brunei advertiser verification, a lease or mortgage agreement is listed as an accepted supporting document.
